text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID). The combination of fever, lower abdominal pain, dysuria, and purulent cervical discharge is highly indicative of an upper genital tract infection. I will now request a Chlamydia and Gonorrhea PCR test to confirm the specific pathogen.
